name: The Shardwright
description: the Carver's apprentice, a thin wiry demon of the Cracked Road: dark slate-grey basalt skin with thin orange seams, a leather apron full of chisels, one hand a long stone chisel, goggles of cracked glass pushed up on his horns, nervous and precise

poses.stand: hovering upright, the chisel hand raised, apron of chisels, goggles on his horns
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers, nervously polishing his chisel hand

attack.action: flicks his chisel hand forward and fires a burst of sharp glowing stone shards forward to the right

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
